principle: Keep a relation visible; leave the surrounding world open to imagination.

images.title: A movement leaves a record
images.insert_after: The marks also include the journey between targets. A crowded middle can suggest a Gaussian distribution: a bell-shaped spread with most values near the average. Here, a central mark may record a crossing rather than a destination. The resemblance does not establish a Gaussian source.
images.caption: Five rods, before touch.
images.alt: Five horizontal rods and beads, with a second axis at the fifth row; the actual arrival state.
images.keep: Rods, beads and any marks already present at arrival; one axis and two axes.
images.omit: Museum architecture, avatar, interface labels and most of the cabinet.
images.limit: Nothing is touched or advanced to prepare this image. A still cannot show speed.
images.question: Can the same targets at four speeds be distinguished from the distribution of positions recorded along the journeys?

images.title: One group stays
images.insert_after: Our touch has acquired another consequence. At the bead, we began a movement that left marks. Here, we keep a group already passing through the page. We have made a small still place in the fall.
images.caption: Page 1, after filling. No group has been held.
images.alt: The top of the generated page after filling, including its heading, independent folio and current rows.
images.keep: Actual generated groups on the full, settled page.
images.omit: Lower page, stand and room; screen-legibility halos around the digits.
images.limit: The page starts with ten seeded rows; the camera waits for every row to fill and settle. These generated digits are not a scan of the historical RAND table. Motion and colour are lost in the print.
images.question: The book image comparison is retired by author choice; the hall wall image and RAND passage remain.

images.title: A beginning becomes intervals
images.insert_after: This is pseudorandom generation: a repeatable calculation whose results can be difficult to anticipate.
images.caption: Gaps in a sequence begun at 435.
images.alt: A cropped counter, dial and an uneven row of event marks above a row of output cells.
images.keep: Counter silhouette, dial and spacing between simulated detection marks.
images.omit: Cabinet boundaries, labels, controls and colour distinctions.
images.limit: The needle and simulated event record are kept at arrival. Monochrome removes the coloured output-bit distinctions; the picture cannot convey the sound.
images.question: Do the gaps carry the passage, or is the cabinet still too present? Would no image leave more room for listening?

wall_works.state: actual arrival; page waits until full and settled
wall_works.book_relation: Arrival PNGs are archived unchanged; book_usage declares any selected later interaction capture. Each published edition freezes its choices; later visits do not rewrite it.

publication_principle: Each image declares what it preserves, what it omits, and whether it records an event or proposes a relation. A meaningful loss can be compared, not silently repaired with invented evidence.

abacus.caption: Five rods, after 48 segments on each row. The contour print keeps the marks as outlines.
abacus.scope: Native Godot capture of a scripted interaction, printed with the contour filter. The untouched arrival state remains separately archived and on the hall wall.
